skills.expectation: Write clean Java 17+ using collections, streams and exceptions
Apply object-oriented design and common design patterns
Build and test a Spring Boot service end to end
Design REST endpoints with proper status codes, validation and pagination
Write efficient queries and understand indexes

Write JUnit tests with mocks for service code
Work with branches, pull requests and code review
Split a system into services and handle failures between them
Produce and consume events with Kafka or RabbitMQ
Package a service in a Docker image
Discuss trade-offs in a basic system design round
